text:
Zoe: ok who else screamed at the surprise guest intro? :scream: :tada:
meeting-bot: Recording started for All-Hands (Q2 Product + Fun Stuff)
Kai: the kazoo cameo was delightfully chaotic 😂
Emma: popcorn.gif :popcorn: (edited)
Sam: mic drop!! :microphone: :boom:  <gif:mic-drop>
Olivia: vote: snack table tomorrow — donuts or empanadas? react with :donut: or :taco:
Devon: donuts for the win. also someone bring napkins pls :sweat_smile:
Zoe: @Olivia I will bring napkins and extra coffee ☕️
Emma: favorite line from the keynote: "Latency is a lifestyle" — solid branding 😆
Kai: can we trademark that? :tm:
Sam: also, shoutout to infra for the smooth deploy demo — looked effortless from here :clap:
Devon: @Sam +1 to infra team, they deserve actual cookies not just kudos :cookie:
Olivia: poll: post-all-hands hangout? 30m in #random or virtual drinks? react :beer: for drinks, :chair: for in-person at HQ
Zoe: adding a tiny tradition: whoever loses the snack poll has to host next week's memes channel takeover :grin:
gif-bot: <gif:confetti-rain>
Emma: that confetti GIF is everything. also can we have subtitles for the next demo? my cat judged the code examples 🐱
Kai: @Emma tell your cat they missed a great commentary on batching :cat: :nerd_face:
Devon: ok low-stakes follow-up — who wants to join the volunteer group for the community event next month? thumbs up if yes :+1:
Sam: thumbs up from me. also, tiny request: can we get captions on the recording? hard to catch accents live sometimes
Zoe: noted — ops will follow up. otherwise: hugs to everyone who stayed late prepping this afternoon :heart:
Olivia: hugs and pizza emojis all around :pizza: :hugging_face:
meeting-bot: Poll closed — Donuts: 6, Empanadas: 3. Drinks: 8, In-person: 2
Zoe: decision made — donuts and a kazoo optional encore tomorrow morning. see y'all! :rocket:
Kai: leaving this thread with a kazoo ringtone in my head for at least 24 hours :kazoo:
Emma: goodnight team, dream of low latency and high snacks :zzz:
